items.problem: Bootstrap silently omitted source, XAML, styles, and assets linked from outside the UWP project directory.
items.evidence: session-log turn 2 copied 4 files; turns 7-12 manually recovered SharedContent files; the source csproj contains Compile/ApplicationDefinition/Page/Content items with Link metadata.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for Link, Compile Include, ApplicationDefinition Include, and Content Include; the script only recursively copied physical files under -Source.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap treated the project directory as the complete source graph instead of honoring linked project items.
items.proposed_fix: Resolve common csproj Include properties for items with Link metadata, copy them to the Link path, include them in mapping/triage, and stop on unresolved links.
items.generalizes: Legacy UWP SDK samples commonly share App, MainPage, styles, helpers, and media through linked project items.

items.problem: Manifest validation omitted AppX capability child ordering.
items.evidence: session-log turn 22: validator reported PASS while winapp registration failed with 0xC00CE014/0x80080204 because rescap:Capability followed DeviceCapability.
items.skill_search: Searched MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 for C00CE014, 80080204, capability order, and DeviceCapability; no ordering rule/check existed.
items.root_cause: The skill checked that runFullTrust existed but not whether capability children conformed to AppX schema order.
items.proposed_fix: Document capability ordering and make the validator reject any non-device capability after the first DeviceCapability.
items.generalizes: Any packaged hardware sample that combines runFullTrust with camera, proximity, Bluetooth, microphone, or other device capabilities can hit this registration failure.

items.problem: The mandatory validator allowed an unavailable launch to return PASS.
items.evidence: session-log turn 40: resources.pri lock produced launch status unavailable, yet Validate-UwpMigration reported PASS; migration-score.json later recorded candidate_launchable=false with Arg_COMException.
items.skill_search: SKILL.md Step 4 and Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 explicitly mapped genuine deploy/environment failure to non-fatal WARN.
items.wrong_text_if_any: A genuine deploy/environment failure (e.g. Developer Mode off) is reported as a non-fatal WARN, not a FAIL.
items.root_cause: An inconclusive launch was treated as successful completion even though the gate's purpose is to prove launchability.
items.proposed_fix: Fail final validation unless the smoke helper observes the process alive; retain the diagnostic distinction between crash and unavailable.
items.generalizes: Registration locks, certificate issues, missing dependencies, and developer-mode failures all prevent launch verification and must not produce success-shaped migration results.
